title: Renewal Applications to the Patient Financial Assistance Program
content:
**Channel.** A renewal application to the Patient Financial Assistance Program is submitted by the applicant in person through the patient portal; an agent does not take a renewal application by phone.

**Assessment.** A renewal application is assessed at a tier: either at the Catastrophic Medical Hardship Adjustment or at the tier of the award being renewed. The result this policy governs is the tier at which the renewal application is assessed.

The tier a renewal application is assessed at is set only after every invoice the award being renewed covers whose payer decision is final carries that award's discount line.

Stated the other way: while any invoice covered by the award being renewed has a final payer decision but carries no discount line of that award, the tier of the renewal application is not yet set.

## The renewal submission

`submit_renewal_application_d691b1b8` is the applicant's own submission, in person through the patient portal, of a renewal application for financial assistance. One call opens one new assistance case for the applicant in submitted status, received today through the online portal, at the tier the applicant selects, with the household size, annual household income and insurance status the applicant enters, with no presumptive enrollment and nothing granted yet. On success the new case appears among the applicant's assistance cases with its own reference number.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks `submit_renewal_application_d691b1b8` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | The applicant's customer reference number, as read from the profile lookup and given to the applicant | Reference number |
| `variant_name` | The assistance tier the renewal is assessed at | Exactly one of: `Financial Assistance 25% Discount` (the 25% income tier); `Financial Assistance 50% Discount` (the 50% income tier); `Financial Assistance 75% Discount` (the 75% income tier); `Financial Assistance Full Discount` (the full-discount income tier); `Presumptive Eligibility Full Discount` (assessed on a program enrollment); `Catastrophic Medical Hardship Adjustment` (assessed under the medical hardship adjustment) |
| `household_size` | The number of people in the household as the applicant states it | A positive whole number |
| `annual_household_income` | The annual household income the applicant states | USD with 2 decimal places |
| `insurance_status` | Whether the applicant has health coverage | Exactly one of: `uninsured` (no live health coverage); `insured` (at least one live health coverage) |

### Return

On success the submission returns a text rendering of a record with `status` "submitted", `assistance_case_id` (the reference number of the new renewal case), `customer_id` (echoed), `variant_name` (the tier recorded), `application_date` (today, YYYY-MM-DD) and `application_channel` ("online_portal").
